newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 1,300 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Friday.
Through Nogales, Arizona, around 1,000 steer calves were sold at steady prices compared to Thursday.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 92-102 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 82-92 cents/lb.
Through Douglas, Arizona, around 300 head were sold, although not enough to establish market trend prices.
